title: How to Prevent Post-surgery Infections
official: Evaluation of a Bundle of Actions to Prevent Skin Infections
summary: Evaluation of the effectiveness in reducing the bacterial load on the skin of bedridden opatients through the use of two different cleaning and washing systems (swash bathing gloves vs pre-soaped sponges). The evaluation will be carried out on a daily basis and will begin on the first day after surgery for 3 consecutive days

interventions.name: Swab for cleaning, used as first comparator. For this group we want, during these three days and each day, measure skin pH before and after, Coltural exam before and after and time for cleaning
sham group with sponge for skin detersion

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age over 18 -
* Both sexes
* ASA III with need of monitoring
* Major surgery (Hip, Knee- Shoulder-first or revision)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lack of consent
* Poor cooperation
* Post-operative delirium
* Pregnant women
